rules.name: 기선제압
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Tactical Initiative reduces incoming damage by one at equal or lower attacker level

rules.name: 헌신방어
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Devoted Defense buffs the next friendly field unit when the owner is destroyed

rules.name: 격노
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Wrath converts actual HP lost while defending into immediate AP

rules.name: 홀리오오라
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Holy Aura prevents damage when attacker AP is at or below half of defender DP plus HP

rules.name: 얼라이디펜스
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Alliance Defense reduces damage by each other field unit with the same affiliation

rules.name: 레이셜디펜스
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Racial Defense reduces damage by each other field unit with the same race

rules.name: 강한헌신방어
rules.test_name: source Skill2 Strong Devoted Defense buffs every surviving friendly field unit when destroyed

rules.name: 프레셔

boundary_tests: source Skill2 Pressure rounds down with one empty slot and reduces damage with two

source Skill2 Tactical Initiative does not reduce damage when attacker level is higher
source Skill2 Devoted Defense buffs the unit immediately after the destroyed field position
